label: Abstract-only rival of concrete population survives, checked
description: Rival test for the concrete-population premise against its smallest consumer, NecessaryRootFork.necessaryRootTrilemma (premises: concrete population, excluded middle). In an interpretation with one existing non-concrete candidate the abstract-only rival and excluded middle hold and the trilemma fails. This is a model-witnessed survival of the rival, not a refutation or defence of the premise; the interpretation is not claimed metaphysically possible. Excluded middle is supplied by Lean's classical axioms.

research_comparisons.conditions: Control.abstractOnly at its one world: the rival and excluded middle hold; NecessaryRootTrilemma fails. Consumer tested: NecessaryRootFork.necessaryRootTrilemma.
research_comparisons.scope: Same Ontic model, concrete predicate and selected world as the premise; one world, one candidate.
research_comparisons.coverage: One explicitly populated interpretation of the rival; not every abstract-only ontology.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival and the premise cannot both hold on one model, predicate and world (unregistered helper onlyNonConcrete_excludes in the Solution module).
research_comparisons.witness: Control.abstractOnly in Control.AbstractOnlySurvives; abstractOnlySurvives proves the listed conjuncts.
research_comparisons.next_step: Test the rival against the Cogito bearer bridges: with the adopted sense of concrete (esse in re) it denies that the bearer of an occurring thought has esse in re.
